about: What fanout may run. Read by plexus.policy before any tool starts; a tool that breaks a rule is refused and the refusal is written to the bundle.

network.rule: A tool may use the network only when its manifest declares network true AND the call grants that tool by id.

need_grant.screen: reads what is on the display; only on a request that grants it

refuse_tools.chorus: sends the item to several hosted models; costs money and leaves the machine
refuse_tools.sovereign_router_route_request: reports confidence 1 on wrong routes; not a sense until calibrated
